subject: Geography

internalBreakdown.component: Practical: written exam on the practical syllabus

textbooks: Fundamentals of Physical Geography, Class XI (NCERT)
Practical Work in Geography Part I, Class XI (NCERT)
notes: Theory is 35 marks per book (including 5 marks of map work each). Unit codes are prefixed P (Fundamentals of Physical Geography) and I (India: Physical Environment).
Map items are located and labelled on outline maps from official Government of India websites.
No learning-outcomes column is given, so chapter outcomes are left empty.

chapters.name: Geography as a Discipline
topics: Geography as an integrating discipline: spatial and temporal synthesis
Approaches: systematic and regional
Branches: physical, human and bio geography
Physical geography and its importance

chapters.name: The Origin and Evolution of the Earth
topics: Early theories of the origin of the earth; modern theories of the origin of the universe
Formation of stars and planets
Evolution of the earth: lithosphere, atmosphere and hydrosphere
Origin of life

chapters.name: Interior of the Earth
topics: Direct and indirect sources of information about the interior
Earthquakes: waves, shadow zones, types, intensity scales, effects, frequency
Structure of the earth
Volcanoes and volcanic landforms

chapters.name: Distribution of Oceans and Continents
topics: Continental drift theory, evidence and force for drift
Post-drift studies; ocean floor configuration; distribution of earthquakes and volcanoes
Seafloor spreading
Plate tectonics: plate boundaries, rate and forces of movement
Movement of the Indian plate

chapters.name: Geomorphic Processes
topics: Exogenic and endogenic processes
Endogenic: diastrophism, volcanism
Exogenic: weathering, landslides
Soil: processes and factors of soil formation

chapters.name: Landforms and their Evolution
topics: Running water: erosional and depositional landforms
Wind: erosional and depositional landforms

chapters.name: Minerals and Rocks
topics: Major types of rocks and their characteristics

chapters.name: Composition and Structure of Atmosphere
topics: Composition and structure of the atmosphere
Elements of weather and climate

chapters.name: Solar Radiation, Heat Balance and Temperature
topics: Variability of insolation
Heating and cooling of the atmosphere; terrestrial radiation
Heat budget of the earth
Temperature: controlling factors, horizontal distribution, inversion

chapters.name: Atmospheric Circulation and Weather Systems
topics: Horizontal and vertical variation of pressure
Forces affecting wind velocity and direction
General circulation: pressure belts; planetary, seasonal and local winds
Air masses and fronts; tropical and extratropical cyclones; thunderstorms and tornadoes

chapters.name: Water in the Atmosphere
topics: Absolute and relative humidity
Evaporation and condensation; dew, frost, fog, mist and cloud
Precipitation; types and world distribution of rainfall

chapters.name: World Climate and Climate Change
topics: World climate and climate change
notes: Tested through internal assessment: project and presentation.

chapters.name: Water (Oceans)
topics: Hydrological cycle
Major and minor relief features of the ocean floor
Temperature and salinity of ocean waters: factors, horizontal and vertical distribution

chapters.name: Movements of Ocean Water
topics: Waves
Tides
Currents

chapters.name: Biodiversity and Conservation
topics: Biodiversity and conservation
notes: Tested through internal assessment: project and presentation.

chapters.name: Map Work: Physical Geography
topics: Political map of all continents; major oceans; major and minor lithospheric plates; Ring of Fire; Mid-Atlantic Ridge
Major hot deserts: Mojave, Patagonian, Sahara, Gobi, Thar, Great Victoria
Major seas: Black, Baltic, Caspian, Mediterranean, North, Red; Bay of Fundy
Cold currents: Humboldt, California, Falkland, Canaries, West Australian, Oyashio, Labrador
Warm currents: Alaska, Brazilian, Agulhas, Kuroshio, Gulf Stream
Ecological hotspots: Eastern Himalaya, Western Ghats, Indonesia, Eastern Madagascar, Upper Guinean forests, Atlantic forest, Tropical Andes

chapters.name: India: Location
topics: Location, size, latitudinal and longitudinal extent
Indian Standard Time
India and its neighbours

chapters.name: Structure and Physiography
topics: Physiographic divisions: northern and north-eastern mountains, northern plain, peninsular plateau, Indian desert, coastal plains, islands

chapters.name: Drainage System
topics: Drainage patterns
River basin, catchment area, watershed
Himalayan and peninsular river systems
Usability of river water: linking of rivers, problems, water pollution

chapters.name: Climate
topics: Weather and climate; unity and diversity in the monsoon climate
Factors determining the climate of India
Nature and characteristics of the Indian monsoon; rhythm of seasons
Distribution of rainfall; monsoon and economic life
Global warming

chapters.name: Natural Vegetation
topics: Forest types and distribution
Conservation of forests
Wildlife, conservation, biosphere reserves

units.name: Natural Hazards and Disasters: Causes, Consequences and Management

chapters.name: Natural Hazards and Disasters
topics: Natural hazards and disasters: causes, consequences and management
notes: Tested through internal assessment: project and presentation.

chapters.name: Map Work: India Physical Environment
topics: Latitudinal and longitudinal extent; Standard Meridian; Tropic of Cancer; Kanyakumari
Ranges: Karakoram, Garo-Khasi-Jaintia, Aravalli, Vindhya, Satpura, Western and Eastern Ghats; peaks: K2, Kanchenjunga, Nanda Devi, Nanga Parbat, Namcha Barwa, Anaimudi
Passes: Shipki La, Nathu La, Palghat, Bhor Ghat, Thal Ghat; plateaus: Malwa, Chhotanagpur, Meghalaya, Deccan
Coastal plains: Saurashtra, Konkan, North and South Kanara, Malabar, Coromandel, Northern Circars; Andaman and Nicobar, Lakshadweep
Rivers: Brahmaputra, Indus, Satluj, Ganga, Yamuna, Chambal, Damodar, Mahanadi, Krishna, Kaveri, Godavari, Narmada, Tapti, Luni
Lakes: Wular, Sambhar, Chilika, Kolleru, Pulicat, Vembanad; Palk Strait, Rann of Kachchh, Gulfs of Kachchh, Mannar and Khambhat
Areas of highest and lowest temperature and rainfall
Forest types; national parks: Corbett, Kaziranga, Ranthambore, Shivpuri, Simlipal; bird sanctuaries: Keoladeo Ghana, Ranganathittu; wildlife sanctuaries: Periyar, Rajaji, Mudumalai, Dachigam
